step: ADR-015 follow-up item 5 — the platform-role grant/revoke asymmetry (no production change; the mutants prove the suite pins both halves and the audit)
usage: source the DATABASE_* environment of a test template database at migration 0024 or later (acc_r015_base), then: node scripts/mutation/run.mjs scripts/mutation/catalogue/item5-platform-asymmetry.json --out <dir>. Every DB command first applies the migrations to its disposable clone.

argv: npm run db:migrate --workspace @acc/db && cd apps/api && npx jest --selectProjects security --runInBand --forceExit --testPathPatterns platform-role-asymmetry

mutants.title: granting platform roles becomes possible: loadAssignableRole no longer refuses a platform-level role
mutants.killedBy: A: each role — the reseller-scope grant is 403 AUTHZ_PLATFORM_ROLE_REQUIRED and writes nothing

mutants.title: revoking platform roles becomes impossible: loadRole refuses a platform-level role
mutants.killedBy: A: each role — an existing grant is revoked by a platform administrator (204)

mutants.title: platform-role revocation audit is skipped
mutants.killedBy: A: each role — exactly one user_role.revoked row, by the actor, at the grant's scope

mutants.title: the POST DTO admits scopeType: 'platform'
mutants.killedBy: A: each role — a well-formed request whose only fault is scopeType 'platform' is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED naming scopeType

equivalentMutants.title: guard 4 skipped when revoking a platform-level role (assertWithinActorAuthority not called for role.orgId === null)
equivalentMutants.reason: Behaviourally equivalent today, so not run: a platform-scope grant is visible only to a validated platform administrator (RLS user_roles_tenant: app_is_platform_admin()), i.e. a holder of alendei_super_admin, which carries every non-content permission, and platform roles can carry no tenant-content key (R-5) — so guard 4 can never refuse a revocation such an actor can reach. A reseller_admin grant is reachable by a same-reseller reseller administrator, who holds every permission of that role by construction. Forcing it to fail would need an artificial actor or fixture (a platform administrator lacking a permission of a platform role), which the review decision excludes. Guard 4 on revocation stays covered for tenant roles by role-revocation.sec-spec.ts (step6-r11 M1–M7).
